references.text: Moses' face shone after meeting God, which can be compared to the transfiguration of Jesus and his divine nature becoming visible to the disciples.
The vision of the Lord's glory in the temple, where only God is seen in his sanctuary, may reflect the scene where only Jesus is visible to the disciples.
The disciples' recognition of Jesus as the Son of God after seeing him walk on water highlights Jesus' unique divinity and can be connected with his extraordinary presence at the transfiguration.
Luke's version of the transfiguration, in which the disciples see Jesus alone, also emphasizes Jesus' uniqueness and divinity.
